name: Rancho San Joaquin Golf Course
architects: William F. Bell (1964); some listings add Robert Muir Graves

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project CA_CaliforniaGaps_B23 (tile USGS_1M_11_x42y373_CA_CaliforniaGaps_B23, published 2025-08-20; from the 2023 California Gaps lidar), NAD83 / UTM 11N (EPSG:26911), NAVD88 m; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow into the release data-rancho_san_joaquin, clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py raster

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 171532123) bbox 1,007 x 1,391 m in UTM 11N (x 422244-423251, y 3724519-3725910) + about 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (136 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (200 m each side)

scorecard_source: greenskeeper.org scorecard (greenskeeper.org/southern_california/orange_county/Rancho_San_Joaquin_Golf_Course/scorecard.cfm, read 2026-10-31): Black/Blue/White per hole, men's par and stroke index; rows add up to 6431/6158/5709, the same totals GolfPass gives for its Back/Middle/Forward tees. Ratings: greenskeeper men's Black 70.8/128, Blue 69.7/125, White 67.6/119 (GolfPass: Back 70.5/126, Middle 69.4/123, Forward 66.5/116). Unverified third-party card: the club site (ranchosanjoaquin.com) is not reachable from the sandbox. Older card (golfingrecord, GolfPass per-hole table): Gold 6389, Blue 6154/6155, White 5624. Built: Black (back tees) and Blue (developer's overnight call: back tees and Blue, default Blue).
attribution: Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (1 m DEM, 2023 California Gaps lidar)
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-31 (overnight, developer asleep: calls logged in docs/courses/rancho_san_joaquin.md). Standing defaults: every penalty area red, the OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar, trees_off_fairways_m 2. Wind 2-10 mph as Strawberry Farms (inland Orange County, about 7 km from the sea). Theme strawberry_farms reused unchanged (the other Irvine course).
